articles.title: Welcome to Jupiter: The Giant That Could Have Been a Star!
articles.summary: Imagine a planet so big it could swallow 1,300 Earths! Jupiter is a wild world with a storm that's lasted centuries and moons that might hide alien life.

articles.title: Australia: The Land Down Under Full of Surprises!
articles.summary: Australia is a whole continent and country in one! It's home to kangaroos, the world's biggest rock, and some of the deadliest creatures on Earth.

articles.title: Earth, Wind & Fire: The Band That Wanted to Change the World!
articles.summary: A new documentary tells the story of Earth, Wind & Fire, a band that mixed R&B, funk, and soul to make music for everyone. Their founder had a big dream: to change the world through music.
